description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

**Job Description**
**Your Responsibilities:**
Design, develop, enhance, and maintain clean, reusable, and scalable enterprise applications using Core Java, adhering to established coding standards and design patterns.
  
  
Translate functional and technical requirements into effective software solutions, developing unit tests and comprehensive technical documentation.
  
  
Debug application issues, perform root cause analysis, implement fixes, and provide 24/7 production support.
  
  
Manage source code, builds, and CI/CD pipelines using Git, Maven, and Jenkins while actively participating in peer code reviews.

**The Essentials - You Will Have**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

Proficiency with build, version control, and CI/CD tools including Maven, Git, and Jenkins, and IDEs such as IntelliJ IDEA or Eclipse.
  
  
1+ years of experience with SQL and relational databases, paired with debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
  
  
Practical experience using AI-powered coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude) for code generation, refactoring, debugging, and unit testing, with a clear understanding of AI limitations, code validation, and secure handling of proprietary code.

Prior domain experience in PharmaSuite, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), or pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.
  
  
Hands-on experience developing and integrating REST APIs and enterprise-level web services.
  
  
Proficiency with unit testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito) and static code analysis tools such as SonarQube.
  
  
Strong knowledge of DBMS concepts and relational database optimization, including complex SQL queries, joins, indexes, and stored procedures.
  
  
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes (Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets), Helm charts, and application server deployment environments.

You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
  
  
To be a successful Software Engineer-VP, you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Design, develop, test and maintain full-stack applications using Java, Spring/Spring Boot, Microservices and React.
* Develop scalable and high-performance backend services with a strong focus on Java concurrency and multi-threading.
* Build and integrate REST-based microservices and enterprise application components.
* Develop responsive front-end functionality using JavaScript and React.
* Work with SQL databases, including query development, troubleshooting and performance analysis.
* Use Unix/Linux scripting for application support, automation and operational activities.
* Contribute to automated build and CI/CD pipelines and engineering best practices.
* Perform technical analysis, debugging and root-cause investigation for complex application issues.
* Participate in code reviews, testing and continuous improvement of application quality and maintainability.
* Collaborate effectively with developers, architects, QA, business analysts and other stakeholders.

**Essential Technical Skills**

* Java: Strong hands-on expertise in Java development, with deep understanding of Core Java, collections, JVM concepts, exception handling, memory management and performance optimisation.
* Spring / Spring Boot: Strong hands-on expertise across the Spring ecosystem, particularly Spring Boot, with experience designing and developing scalable enterprise applications.
* Multi-threading & Concurrency: Strong practical knowledge of Java multi-threading, concurrency, asynchronous processing and performance optimisation, including diagnosing and resolving concurrency and performance issues.
* Microservices: Strong experience designing, developing and supporting microservices, with good understanding of API design, service decomposition, resiliency, scalability, observability and integration patterns.
* Unix/Linux: Strong hands-on experience with Unix/Linux, including scripting, application troubleshooting and production support.
* SQL & Databases: Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL, including complex queries, data-access patterns and database performance considerations.
* Build & CI/CD: Strong understanding of build tools, source control and CI/CD practices, including automated build, testing, deployment and release pipelines.
* JavaScript & React: Hands-on development experience with JavaScript and React, with the ability to contribute across the application stack.
* Engineering & Architecture: Ability to make sound technical and architectural decisions, ensuring solutions meet scalability, resilience, maintainability, security and performance requirements.

Good to Have
  
  
  

* Experience with React Redux or similar state-management frameworks.
* Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes and modern containerisation/orchestration practices.
* Experience implementing and supporting automated build, deployment and release pipelines.
* Experience developing high-volume, low-latency or performance-sensitive enterprise applications.
* Exposure to observability, monitoring, production troubleshooting and performance tuning.
* Experience working within large-scale financial services or other complex enterprise technology environments.

Professional & Leadership Skills
  
  
  

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to independently resolve complex technical challenges.
* Demonstrated end-to-end technical ownership, from solution design and development through testing, deployment and production stability.
* Ability to provide technical direction and engineering guidance while remaining hands-on with development.
* Strong focus on code quality, automated testing, maintainability, resilience and engineering best practices.
* Ability to conduct effective code reviews and technical/design reviews and drive engineering standards across the team.
* Ability to identify technical, delivery and production risks early and drive pragmatic solutions.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering, product and business stakeholders.
* Ability to mentor and guide engineers, promoting knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
* Strong collaboration across Engineering, Architecture, Product, QA, DevOps and Production Support.
* Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and take ownership of complex technical decisions and delivery outcomes.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
